system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 43. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (25 seconds, code score 0.91) ---
[b00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, denying): "I didn't!"
[b01] ALEXANDER (resonant, accusatory): "And when you believed I was dead..."
[b02] ALEXANDER (venomous): "You took my title."
[b03] SFX: Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
[b04] CROWN OFFICIAL (grave, official): "Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."
[b05] CROWN OFFICIAL: "Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."
[b06] CROWN OFFICIAL (loud, authoritative): "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."
[b07] BLOND NOBLEMAN (screaming, desperate): "I was told he was dead!"

--- WINDOW 1 (46 seconds, code score 0.86) ---
[b00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (enraged, screaming): "I said arrest him!"
[b01] ACTION: The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.
[b02] ROYAL GUARD (firm, defiant): "We will not."
[b03] BLOND NOBLEMAN (outraged, stunned): "I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!"
[b04] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate): "Your Duke!"
[b05] ROYAL GUARD (calm, resolute): "No. He is your Duke."
[b06] ACTION: The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.
[b07] ACTION: Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
[b08] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, flustered): "You have all been deceived!"
[b09] ALEXANDER (cold, authoritative): "Then let the Crown decide."
[b10] ACTION: Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
[b11] ALEXANDER (grave, powerful): "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."
[b12] ALEXANDER (commanding): "Read the first."
[b13] ACTION: The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
[b14] SFX: Crisp sound of parchment turning.
[b15] CROWN OFFICIAL (clear, formal): "Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."
[b16] CROWN OFFICIAL (solemn, objective): "Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised."
[b17] CROWN OFFICIAL (accusing, measured): "The report identifies the leak as deliberate."
[b18] CROWN OFFICIAL (voice continuing): "Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels."
[b19] ACTION: Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
[b20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (whispering, terrified): "No..."

--- WINDOW 2 (20 seconds, code score 0.80) ---
[b00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (whispering, terrified): "No..."
[b01] ALEXANDER (cold, implacable): "Read the names."
[b02] CROWN OFFICIAL (deliberate, damning): "Lord Henry Sterling."
[b03] CROWN OFFICIAL: "Rupert Ashburn."
[b04] DOWAGER DUCHESS (shaken, devastated): "My God..."
[b05] ALEXANDER (furious, thunderous): "You sold my men to the enemy."
[b06] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, denying): "I didn't!"
[b07] ALEXANDER (resonant, accusatory): "And when you believed I was dead..."

--- WINDOW 3 (20 seconds, code score 0.76) ---
[b00] CROWN OFFICIAL (loud, authoritative): "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."
[b01] BLOND NOBLEMAN (screaming, desperate): "I was told he was dead!"
[b02] ALEXANDER (cold, penetrating): "You were told exactly what you needed to hear."
[b03] BLOND NOBLEMAN (frantic, betraying): "Sterling handled the report!"
[b04] CATHERINE (shocked, murmuring): "My Lord?"
[b05] SFX: Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.

Pick the single best promo.
